thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired - alert: LB targets unhealthy (TLS handshake failures) in us-west-2. PD incident: #INC-20260314-42
Sam: ack - I'm oncall and jumping in.
Maya: on it. seeing TLS handshake error rates spike ~10:45 UTC, increased 5xx.
Dario: looks correlated with a routing weight change that rolled out at 10:40.
Jules: PD notified customers via status page? I can draft a short note.
Sam: yes please. Maya, can you confirm if it's ALB or backend cert? curl to edge shows SNI mismatch on some targets.
Maya: running curl against a failing host now: `curl -v https://edge-usw2.redwood.example |& grep -i sni`
Maya: output: `SSL3_GET_SERVER_CERTIFICATE:certificate verify failed` on 3/12 targets.
Dario: checking ALB target health: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-0abc` 
Dario: target health: Unhealthy (TLS handshake) for targets in ASG web-usw2-a.
incident-bot: escalated to secondary oncall after 10m without ack from ops.
Sam: ack the PD, I'm triaging. rolling traffic off unhealthy targets to healthy pool now. will also revert the 10:40 weight change if needed.
Jules: updating incident channel and PD with initial impact: ~25% of requests in us-west-2 returning TLS/502, intermittent errors for customers in US-West.
Maya: quick test: SNI header from ALB to backend seems missing for new envoy config. suspect proxy TLS passthrough misconfig after recent envoy bump.
Dario: logs show envoy 1.21 deployed to web-usw2-a at 10:38. patch contains `--enable-client-sni=false` accidentally.
Sam: that matches. mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic to web-usw2-b/c (healthy) 2) rollback envoy bump on a 3) verify ALB target health and TLS handshake.
Maya: starting failover now: increasing weight to b/c via router API (`POST /api/v1/route/update {weights...}`)
Dario: rolling back envoy on web-usw2-a via deploy rollback job `deploy/rollback web-usw2-a envoy:1.20`. kicking it off.
Jules: PD: note added - mitigation in progress, customers seeing errors in us-west-2 only, mitigation attempt started.
Sam: monitoring metrics - TLS handshake errors falling on the cluster as traffic moves off a. keep an eye on latency.
Maya: ALB target health checks now passing on web-usw2-a after rollback. `TargetHealth: healthy` on 6/6.
Dario: confirms envoy rollback completed at 10:58.
incident-bot: PD incident acknowledged by sam, status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Jules: sending status update to customers: short note posted to status.redwood.example: "Partial disruption in us-west-2 affecting a subset of requests; mitigation applied and we're monitoring. Follow-up investigation ongoing."
Sam: handing off to Dario for post-incident follow-up. Dario you're 2nd oncall for next hour, take it.
Dario: taking handoff. will run RCA and postmortem. initial root cause: bad envoy flag in deploy causing SNI omission on upstream TLS, rollback fixed.
Maya: saved relevant logs and deployment diffs to the incident runbook.
Jules: PD: incident resolved at 11:04 UTC, customer-facing note updated with resolution and next steps.
Sam: nice work team. A few action items: 1) add deploy preflight TLS smoke tests 2) block merging config flags that disable client SNI without explicit review 3) improve deploy rollback automation to reduce time to mitigate.
Dario: I'll own the postmortem and track action items in the infra backlog.
Jules: closing the PD incident and adding timeline. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident thread closed (auto) after 20m of stable metrics.
